4. Question 4: Copies of the entry logbooks for the FS pump rooms in Wang Fuk Court referred to in paragraph 10.2 of my 1st Witness Statement

4.1 The information pertaining to the entry logbooks for the FS pump rooms in Wang Fuk Court as mentioned in paragraph 10.2 of my 1st Witness Statement is derived from the details provided by the Police at the time I rendered my statement. According to information from Police, each of the 8 blocks maintained a logbook and the management office of Wang Fuk Court maintained a master logbook for 8 blocks. The master logbook kept at the management office and the logbooks kept at 4 of the 8 blocks1 are now in the Police’s custody, while logbooks of the remaining 4 blocks2 could not be located during the Police’s investigation. Copies of the said logbooks obtained by the Police are now produced. Two observations can be made.
